articles.title: A Cosmic Vanishing Act: Venus Will Slip Behind the Moon This Month
articles.summary: On June 17, a lunar occultation will hide Venus from view for observers in the Americas. The Moon will pass in front of the brilliant planet, making it disappear and then reappear. This rare alignment is just one highlight of a packed June sky, including a tight Venus-Jupiter conjunction and the summer solstice.

articles.title: A Towering Wave of Warm Water Is Marching Across the Pacific—And It Could Trigger a Global Weather Shake-Up
articles.summary: Satellite data reveal a massive Kelvin wave—a bulge of warm water over 5.9 inches higher than normal—moving from the western Pacific to South America. This phenomenon is a classic precursor to El Niño, a climate pattern that can disrupt weather worldwide, from droughts to floods.

articles.title: A Stellar Rosetta Stone: Astronomers Pin Down the Source of Baffling Radio Signals
articles.summary: An international team has traced mysterious long-period radio transients to a cataclysmic variable system: a white dwarf accreting matter from a red dwarf. The binary, ASKAP J1745−5051, orbits every 1.4 hours and emits synchronized radio and X-ray pulses, offering a key to decoding similar cosmic enigmas.
